title: REQ · BootScene.create stores the transitionTo unsubscribe function
summary: The function returned by reactToPhaser.on('transitionTo') is kept in unsubscribeTransition
description: Context: BootScene declares unsubscribeTransition at L33 and assigns it in create at L76. Desired behavior: the handle is retained so it can be released later. Expected result: after create the field holds the unsubscribe function, and one emit produces one fade. Why: without the handle the subscription could never be released.
acceptance_criteria: Given create has run, when transitionTo is emitted once, then fadeOut is called exactly once with the transition duration
Given the scene is shut down and created again, when transitionTo is emitted once, then fadeOut is called exactly once in total

preserve: existing transitionTo fade and start logic

definition_of_done: Field assigned from reactToPhaser.on return value
